title: Gunshot to the thigh
summary: A rifleman takes a round to the left thigh and a graze to the right forearm. He is awake and bleeding heavily. You are the nearest combat lifesaver.
objectives: Stop the life-threatening leg bleed with a tourniquet as fast as possible
Treat pain once bleeding is controlled
Patient alive and not bleeding at the end
Splint the leg if it is fractured
